scope_statement: Functional source and test evidence only. No hosted workflow (neither nonprod-deploy nor dev-tw-market-refresh nor any other GitHub Actions workflow) was dispatched. Hosted behaviour was NOT exercised: no VM, SSH, operator key, broker, broker sandbox, futures smoke, model provider call, or real capital was used. Hosted acceptance belongs to INSTRUMENT-EXPRESSION-HOSTED-ACCEPTANCE-20261107.
commands: python3 -m pytest -q scripts/test_deploy_nonprod_vm.py  => 73 passed, 2 skipped in 100.12s (exit 0)

acceptance_mapping.1_validate_source_refresh_profile_connec: validate_source_refresh_profile in scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh accepts SOURCE_INGEST_BOUNDED_CONNECTOR_ID=tw-taifex-futures-options-chip only when PANTHEON_EXTERNAL_EGRESS_ALLOWED_HOSTS normalizes to the exact two-host set {openapi.taifex.com.tw, www.taifex.com.tw} in either order (and requires SOURCE_INGEST_BOUNDED_DATASET=taifex_ssf_contracts when set), preserves the exact {openapi.twse.com.tw, www.twse.com.tw, www.tpex.org.tw} host set for tw-twse-tpex-official-market, and rejects any partial, extra, merged, or wildcard host entry or any unapproved connector ID. Covered by test_deploy_nonprod_bootstrap_contract.py, test_source_ingest_deploy_diagnostics_contract.py, and test_dev_tw_market_refresh.py.
acceptance_mapping.2_workflows_dispatch_taifex_ssf_contract: .github/workflows/nonprod-deploy.yml and .github/workflows/dev-tw-market-refresh.yml dispatch taifex_ssf_contracts as a separate bounded refresh step immediately after the TWSE refresh step, using fixed per-run SOURCE_INGEST_BOUNDED_CONNECTOR_ID=tw-taifex-futures-options-chip, PANTHEON_EXTERNAL_EGRESS_ALLOWED_HOSTS=openapi.taifex.com.tw,www.taifex.com.tw, and SOURCE_INGEST_BOUNDED_DATASET=taifex_ssf_contracts without adding a workflow schedule. check_taiwan_refresh_preflight in scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh is connector- and dataset-aware so a fresh TWSE snapshot never suppresses a missing/stale/wrong-dataset TAIFEX SSF pull; prepare_bounded_source_refresh_dataset in scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh wires SOURCE_INGEST_BOUNDED_DATASET=taifex_ssf_contracts through build_active_universe_job_fanout, TaifexDerivativesChipAdapter, /api/source-ingest/connectors, /api/source-ingest/active-universe/schedule (job_parameters), and controller_worker.run_schedule_tick so the 5 SSF endpoints are fetched and dataset-specific readback (tw_taifex_ssf_contracts.v1) is enforced by verify_bounded_source_refresh_readback. Covered by test_source_ingest_deploy_diagnostics_contract.py, test_deploy_nonprod_vm.py, and test_dev_tw_market_refresh.py.
acceptance_mapping.3_no_wildcard_no_host_widening_and_regre: SOURCE_REFRESH_ALLOWED_HOSTS normalization in scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh appends www.twse.com.tw only when SOURCE_REFRESH_CONNECTOR_ID == tw-twse-tpex-official-market and never widens TAIFEX or merges TWSE/TPEx and TAIFEX host lists. Regression tests in test_source_ingest_deploy_diagnostics_contract.py, test_deploy_nonprod_vm.py, and test_deploy_nonprod_env_parity.py fail if any wildcard appears in host lists or if TWSE/TPEx and TAIFEX host lists are merged.
acceptance_mapping.4_evidence_records_commands_results_and_: docs/deployment/evidence/DEV-EGRESS-TAIFEX-CONNECTOR-GATE-20261107/evidence.json records the exact pytest validation commands and results and states plainly that no hosted workflow was dispatched.
